name_input: LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED; LLOYDS STEELS INDUSTRIES LIMITED; LLOYDS STEELS INDUSTRIES LIMITED; LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED; LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED; LLOYDS STEELS INDUSTRIES LIMITED; LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED; LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED; LLOYDS STEELS INDUSTRIES LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey (https://importkey.com/countries/india/lloyds-engineering-works-limited), counter 'Total Shipments 199 Records detected', rows actually visible on the free page: 5 shipment rows + 5 supplier rows + 1 buyer row. Export-side lanes visible in the 'Top Ports' block: 'SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC 16', 'LONDON HEATHROW 13', 'CHICAGO IL 3' — i.e. outbound air lanes to UK and USA. Buyer block row: 'SOLAR TURBINES ACOUSTICS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED, SISCO ENERGY PRIVATE LIMITED, C/O MDS AERO SUPPORT CORP TEST CELL 6 215 E CENTER PARK BLVD BLDG.A DESETO TX 75115 UNITED STATES' (23 shipments). The 5 dated rows shown are all INBOUND (e.g. '2026-02-26 BEIJING GLOBAL TECHNOTRADE GROUP (BGTG) LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED ... Shanghai, CHINA -> NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India 84238900 7753283'), so no dated outbound row with destination+HS+B/L was visible in the free view.
note: Two legal entities appear in the batch: LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED (plot A-5/5 & A-6/3, MIDC Industrial Area, Murbad, Dist. Thane — address as printed in the ImportKey header) and LLOYDS STEELS INDUSTRIES LIMITED. For LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED the customs record is real and dated (latest cargo 2026-02-26), but the free view exposes only inbound rows; outbound evidence is limited to aggregate port counters (Sahar Air Cargo 16, London Heathrow 13, Chicago IL 3) and a US buyer relationship (Solar Turbines Acoustics / MDS Aero Support, 23 shipments) — direction of those 23 is not stated on the page, so export is classed confirmed on the strength of the Heathrow/Chicago outbound lanes but WITHOUT a dated B/L row, destination HS and B/L number, which are behind the paywall and recorded as null. For LLOYDS STEELS INDUSTRIES LIMITED the ImportKey page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/lloyds-steels-industries-limited) returned an empty record set — 'Loading...' with no shipment rows, no suppliers, no buyers — so no shipment evidence was found for that entity at all; it is not the same customs record as the engineering-works entity. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: web_search was unavailable throughout the session (searx connection refused) and the company sites lloydssteels.com and lloydsengg.com did not resolve, while volza and eximpedia returned HTTP 403. Domestic status therefore unknown, not 'none_found' — absence of retrieval, not absence of supply. Declared HS 840681 (steam/other vapour turbines over 40 MW) does not match the observed inbound cargo (84238900 weighing systems, 84314100 grab buckets, 84833000 bearing housings, 84836090 swivel joints, 84213990 PCI bag house) — the company reads as an engineering fabricator of steel-plant and marine-unloading equipment rather than a turbine maker; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, HS should be corrected to the actual product line. Revenue and export volume: null, not public in the sources reached.
